abilities.name: Icy Paws
abilities.caveat: Assumes every paw lands — 2 on Press, 5 on Hold — so the shield is drawn at its full length. Fewer hits give a shorter one.
_curatorNotes: Shield effects authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (sidecar 'Base Shield DMG Absorption' row, 10th column: 13.0% Max HP + 1524; gcsim pawShieldPer[9]=0.1296, pawShieldFlat[9]=1524.29). Base effects[] = Press: scaling 12.96% Max HP, duration 4.8s (2 paws × pawDur[9]=2.4s). Hold variant overrides with ×1.75 absorption bonus: 12.96 × 1.75 = 22.68% Max HP, duration 12s (5 paws × 2.4s). Assumes all paws hit — per-paw shield formation/duration-stacking (gcsim pawsPewPew shield extension, capped at 5 × pawDur) not expressible.

↻ 2026-08-18 (stale-note pass): CLOSED, and the note was already false when the flag found it. It used to read "Schema gap: shield Effect has no `flat` field (heal does) — the flat absorption portion (1524.29 Press / 2667.51 Hold at TL10) is dropped." `ShieldEffect.flat` was added 2026-07-12 — src/lib/types/ability.ts:1331-1336 names DIONA +1524 as one of the three cases that motivated it (with Thoma +1525 and Yun Jin +2542) — and BOTH shield effects in this file author it (base 1524.29, Hold variant 2667.51). Nothing is dropped at the data layer.

⚠️ 2026-08-18 — but do not read the line above as "the number now shows": `Effect.flat` has no RENDERER. Grepped across src, the only reader outside the type declaration is `characterLint.ts:2053` (a shape check). The shield lane draws a labelled SPAN and nothing else (`shieldRows.ts` carries start/end/label/source only), the Team Builder's shield capability carries no magnitude, and neither does `scaling`. That is by design, not a gap — the tool visualizes mechanics and never computes a verdict — so the honest statement is that the absorption VALUE (scaling and flat alike) is authored, correct, and deliberately not surfaced anywhere.

Shield target 'active': shield forms on the point-of-formation active character and persists across swaps protecting whoever is on-field (KQM TCL confirms Cryo self-application re-applies on swap). 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive — same as Kaeya/Yanfei notes).
C2 multiplies shield absorption ×1.15 and adds a 50%-strength splash shield for off-field members (5s) — not composed here; see C2 node notes.
A1 Cat's Tail Secret Menu grants shielded characters +10% Movement SPD / -10% Stamina Consumption only (gcsim asc.go) — no shield-duration extension exists; out of combat-model scope, not authored.

Creates a Cryo shield on hit; shield HP scales with Diona's Max HP and number of paws landed (Press fires 2 paws, Hold fires 5 paws; Hold gets 1.75x bonus). Shield duration from pawDur[] table in skill.go — depends on how many paws hit. Shield is a caster-status buff (not a spawned entity); no summons[] authored.
Hold variant cooldownStartDelay = 29 (skillHoldHitmark in gcsim) — AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field; recorded here per recipe schema-gap note.
Press variant cooldownStartDelay = 5 (skillPressHitmark). Base ability cooldownStartDelay reflects Press variant.
[A7] Shield duration = 2.4s per paw landed at talent level 10 (pawDur[9]); the caveat text now conveys the paws-scaling qualitatively. Already recorded in existing curator notes.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Assumes every paw lands — 2 on Press, 5 on Hold — so absorption and duration are shown at maximum. Fewer hits give a weaker, shorter shield."
abilities.description:
Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.

Press
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.

abilities.name: Signature Mix
_curatorNotes: Heal + Cryo tick authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10. Tick cadence verified against gcsim burst.go ('ticks every 2s, first tick at t=2s relative to field start... 6 ticks') and KQM TCL/wiki (first activation 2s after field start, every 2s, 6 activations). Authored as summonTick interval 2 / firstTickDelay 2 on the Drunken Mist summon — with duration 12.5 that yields ticks at t=2..12 (6 ticks), matching gcsim.

Heal per tick TL10: 9.60% of Diona's Max HP + 1129.1 flat (sidecar 'HP Regeneration Over Time' 10th column '9.60% Max HP+1129'; gcsim burstHealPer[9]=0.096048, burstHealFlat[9]=1129.1038). Target 'active' — gcsim heals c.Core.Player.Active() only when within the field area; KQM confirms 'characters within the AoE'. NOTE: capability fixture (scripts/capability-expectations.mjs) expects target 'team' for this heal — fixture appears wrong vs in-game behavior; flagged for orchestrator, not editable in this pass's scope.
Heal snapshots Diona's Max HP and Healing Bonus at cast (gcsim: snap/maxhp/heal captured in Burst() before the tick tasks are queued).

Cryo tick TL10: 94.75% ATK (sidecar 'Continuous Field DMG' 10th column 94.8%; gcsim burstDot[9]=0.94752), snapshotted at cast (QueueAttackWithSnap). Initial cast hit (144% ATK at TL10, hitmark 58f) not authored as an effect — planner renders cast damage via FrameMap, matching corpus convention.
Field duration: kit table says 12s; gcsim status 'diona-q' runs 750f = 12.5s from field start ('apparently lasts for 12.5'). summons.duration 12.5 kept from frames pass.
A4 Drunkards' Farce (enemy ATK -10% in field) remains unauthored — not implemented in gcsim, see passive node note.
[A7] Field is stationary (summon mobility 'stationary'); the caveat's 'standing inside the field' conveys the fixed-position sense for users.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The summon lane draws tick marks that say a tick FIRED; it never names a recipient, and the heal is already authored `target: 'active'`, so the tool is not claiming a team heal. What is left is positioning — standing inside the field, the vertical range — which the tool has no geometry for and never draws. Working behaviour plus a positional omission. Category: invisible-omission.

passives.name: Choice Treasures
_curatorNotes: Witch's Revelation Passive (additional talent unlocked by the 'Witch's Revelation: Special Blend's Instruction' quest; Lunar Arcanum II The High Priestess, Reversed). Authored 2026-07-29 from the Fandom wiki page 'Choice Treasures' (Talent Infobox |info, rev. 2026-07-15) and 'Witch's Revelation Passive'. gcsim has no Stellar implementation as of 5d1ec8c79 — wiki is the sole source per docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md.

No effects authored. Clause 1 (auto-fired Icy Paws on team Superconduct / Stellar-Conduct / Cryo Swirl, 20s window after Icy Paws, once per 3.5s) is pure DMG output: the wiki text explicitly states these paws 'cannot generate Elemental Particles, nor will they generate a shield upon hitting opponents', so there is NO team-facing shield or energy hook to author. Damage magnitude is out of scope per the tool constitution. NOTE: the game8 summary implied a shield component — wiki contradicts it; trust the wiki.

Clause 1 is NOT stellar-gated: Superconduct and Cryo Swirl fire it with no enabler present, so no teamEnablesReaction condition applies. Its own gates (20s post-skill window + 3.5s proc CD) would need a damage-emitting effect to hang on; none exists.

Clause 2 ('when inside a Polestar Field, Diona will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state') carries no stat payload of its own — it is the unlock for the C6 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct' block, which IS authored (see the C6 node). Polestar Fields only exist while Stellar-Conduct is enabled, which is why the C6 effect is gated on teamEnablesReaction:stellarConduct.
No scaling sidecar row exists for this talent (docs/curation/talents/diona.json predates the Revelation passive); the wiki page lists scale_att1 = ATK but publishes no per-level table.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — that can be named. The paws are explicitly damage-only — the wiki text the curator note quotes says they generate no particles and no shield — so no bar, no shield span and no energy is missing. The one candidate pixel would be extra Cryo application pips on the aura lane, but no source gives these paws a gauge, so the caveat cannot honestly claim it; the rest (the 20s window, the 3.5s cadence) is cadence for something the tool never draws. Category: invisible-omission.

constellations.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
constellations.caveat: The Elemental Mastery and Incoming Healing bars are drawn together, and the three Reaction Bonus lines whenever a teammate enables Stellar-Conduct; in game a character gets only the one their HP qualifies for, the Reaction Bonus lines also need a Polestar Field, and all of them need standing inside the burst's radius.
_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-08-18 (stale-note pass) — ⛔ THE HEADLINE OF THIS NOTE WAS WRONG IN THE DIRECTION THAT MATTERS. It used to open "Only EM buff (+200 EM) is modeled", which told a future curator the bigger half was already covered. It is not: the +200 EM effect carries `trigger: 'manual'`, and `manual` has exactly ONE mention in src — the type declaration at src/lib/types/ability.ts:649. No collector, no proc, no stack dispatcher, no notation token and NO TOGGLE (167 manual effects across 69 characters are in this state). So NOTHING of the HP-based block reaches the planner: no bar, no marker. The chip strip does not carry it either — `TeamBonusesBlock` lists a constellation only for `trigger: 'passive'` buff/resShred effects, so at C6 the "Cat's Tail Closing Time" chip appears (on the strength of the +25% Max HP effect below) and its tooltip lists ONLY that +25% Max HP row. ⚠️ The one place the EM does surface is the Team Builder: `deriveCapabilities` applies no trigger gate, so it emits `{ kind: 'buff', detail: 'em', target: 'self', minConstellation: 6 }` (measured 2026-08-18) — a TB claim with no planner counterpart.

Kit facts, unchanged and still the authoring brief: the effect is HP-conditional on the RECIPIENT — HP > 50% → EM +200 to the active character in the field; HP ≤ 50% → Incoming Healing Bonus +30% to the active character in the field. gcsim re-checks every 30 frames (0.5s) for the Signature Mix duration. The +30% Incoming Healing Bonus half is still entirely unauthored. ⛔ Neither half is authorable today and the reason is a CONDITION gap, not a trigger-shape guess: `recipientHpBelow` / `selfHpBelow` / `enemyHpBelow` all fall through one `return null` in `conditions.ts:201-210`, and `ConditionContext` has six fields, none of them HP — so an HP-gated pair would render BOTH branches optimistically at once. ⏭ WORK ITEM once HP enters `ConditionContext`: re-trigger both effects as `onCast ability:'burst'`, `target: 'active'`, `duration: 12.5` (matching the three Radiance effects below and the authored Drunken Mist window), gated on the HP condition, and add the `incomingHealingBonus` half — the Stat key already exists (ability.ts). Until then, ⚠️ note that the authored `target: 'self'` does not match the kit either (the buff lands on the active character standing in the radius, not on Diona), and because `deriveCapabilities` reads `target` regardless of trigger, that mismatch is visible in the TB even though the effect fires nowhere — the same "an inert effect's target is still a claim" lesson as the Nicole C2 shield ruling (2026-08-18). Leaving it is a decision, not an oversight; a change here needs `npm run generate-character-index`.

[Stellar round 2026-07-29] The Witch's Revelation enhances this constellation. Source: Fandom 'Cat's Tail Closing Time' Constellation Infobox |buff (buffType=Revelation, rev. 2026-07-04). Enhanced text adds two clauses to the unchanged HP-based block: (a) 'Additionally, Diona's Max HP is increased by 25%.' and (b) 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Characters within Signature Mix's radius deal 40% increased Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, and Cryo Swirl Reaction DMG.'

[Stellar round] Clause (a) +25% Max HP authored as a PERMANENT self buff (trigger 'passive', stat hp%, value 25) — the enhanced wording carries no Stellar/Polestar Field qualifier, matching the permanent-kit-patch class the Hexerei round documented. No talent scaling (flat constellation value).

[Stellar round] Clause (b) authored stellar-gated: conditions {type:'teamEnablesReaction', reaction:'stellarConduct'}. Justification — the 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct' state is entered only 'when inside a Polestar Field' (wiki 'Choice Treasures'), and Polestar Fields exist only where Stellar-Conduct is enabled, i.e. an enabler (currently Sandrone alone) is in the party. Trigger onCast burst / duration 12.5 / fixed mirrors the authored Drunken Mist summon duration (gcsim 'diona-q' = 750f); target 'active' matches the burst heal's in-radius convention rather than this node's legacy 'self'.

[Stellar round, updated 2026-07-29 under Nate's bucket-5 ruling] All three thirds of clause (b) are now authored on the Reaction-Bonus stat family (stellarConduct/superConduct/cryoSwirl ReactionBonus — bucket 5, additive with the EM bonus; the wiki's 'Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus Constellations' category maps there). The whole Radiance clause is field-gated in game, so all three ride teamEnablesReaction with the field caveat — including the Superconduct and Cryo Swirl halves, which without the Radiance state do not apply at all.

[Stellar round] The narrower real gate (Polestar Field present AND target standing in the burst radius) is beyond the condition vocabulary; carried in the caveat instead. The in-radius restriction also applies to the pre-existing EM buff and is unchanged by this pass.

[Stellar round] Wiki 'Stellar-Conduct' page confirms the Base Reaction Coefficient table reads 1 / 1.45 / … / 2.0 (1 + 0.40 + 0.05×n, n≤12) — resolves the NEEDS-CONFIRM in docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md in favour of the assumed reading. Not a Diona effect; recorded for the doc owner.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 Cat's Tail Closing Time — effects[0] (buff em 200) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `diona/cons.go:26-61` (`c6`), called from `diona/burst.go:75` — a task every 30f for 750f checks the ACTIVE character: inside `burstBuffArea` (radius 7, `burst.go:48`) and `CurrentHPRatio() > 0.5` → +200 EM for 120f; else → +0.3 Incoming Healing Bonus for 120f. Keep the 0.5s re-check cadence and the 120f per-grant length as the reason `duration: 12.5` is the window and not the grant; retire the "⛔ Neither half is authorable today" paragraph — `recipientHpBelow` resolving to `null` and rendering optimistically IS the house behaviour, so the condition gap was never the blocker. ⚠️ Both branches draw at once — that is the optimistic-render contract, carried by the caveat. ⚠️ `not(recipientHpBelow: 50)` is *not* HP ≥ 50: the kit's healing branch is "≤ 50%" and ours is "< 50%", a one-point edge that no surface can resolve. The active-target pass dedupes by `stat` — `em` and `incomingHealingBonus` differ, and both differ from the three `*ReactionBonus` effects on this node, so nothing collapses. A change here needs `npm run generate-character-index`.
constellations.description:
Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
·Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.
Additionally, Diona's Max HP is increased by 25%.

Radiance: Stellar-Conduct
Characters within Signature Mix's radius deal 40% increased Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, and Cryo Swirl Reaction DMG.
